answer: A submission quota caps how many answers one identity may post each epoch. Every wallet carries a token bucket that refills only from grading it has genuinely passed; a basalt-heavy farm of cloned accounts each starts near empty, so a thousand wallets cannot out-produce a few veterans combined. Scaling output forces the attacker to earn standing per identity, an ivory-slow grind across epochs on every island of accounts rather than a script that merely spawns more. Cost is N patient reputational ramps, not one.
